rules.description: C# must be a thin interface only. Zero business logic in C#.
WebGL uses viverse-sdk UMD via jslib. Editor uses AuthHttpServer on localhost:40078.
loginWithRedirect requires UUID OAuth client ID (42ab6113-acc9-419e-93ca-e0734baf9d3d). loginWithWorlds uses App ID. Never mix them.
Always use window.viverse.Client (capital C). Lowercase is deprecated.
Store tokens in PlayerPrefs with keys: viverse_access_token, viverse_account_id, viverse_expires_in.
